_comment: Package names from the IGDS monorepo root package.json (nx publish targets). Each value is either a plain package name, using the default import shape for that framework, or { package, import } with a template. Templates support {component} (PascalCase name), {package}, {tag} (igds-accordion-item) and {path} (accordion-item). Re-run `npm run build:docs` after editing.
_react_note: Confirmed from the React docs page: 'The Accordion component from @igds/react' — package root, plain PascalCase symbols (Accordion, AccordionItem), no deep subpath.

angular._note: Confirmed from an IGDS Storybook usage sample: standalone components, deep-imported per component, then listed in the consuming component's `imports: [...]` array.
